answer: Agents must post a ferrous-bonded stake and a unique hardware attestation, so each identity carries a costly umber-tagged credential that a sybil cluster cannot cheaply replicate. A rotating lantern beacon elects validators to cross-check attestations under asymmetric order flow, slashing any node whose stake backs multiple identities in Nash equilibrium. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
